story: Few birds capture the imagination quite like the Reeves Pheasant (Syrmaticus reevesii). As a member of the Phasianidae family, it has carved out a unique niche in Evergreen forests; open woodland; mixed forest; and hilly/mountainous areas at 300–1800 m. Its conservation status is Vulnerable (VU), a classification that drives crucial research and protection efforts. The Reeves Pheasant's presence is a vital sign of its ecosystem's health, making its preservation a priority. This poster is a tribute to the Reeves Pheasant, celebrating its role in the natural world and inspiring a deeper appreciation for biodiversity.
